beats.say: Uttar Pradesh is about the size of the United Kingdom.
beats.cap: UP ≈ UK in area (240,928 vs 243,610 km²)

beats.say: But in twenty twenty-six, it is projected to have three and a half times as many people.
That's about two hundred and forty-three million. A projection: India's last census was in twenty eleven.
Counted as a country, it would rank sixth in the world.
beats.cap: As a country: 6th in the world (UN list, 2026)

beats.say: Pakistan would be just above it, and Nigeria about level.
In the last census, one in six Indians lived in Uttar Pradesh.
Land the size of the UK. A crowd the size of the sixth-largest country.
